description: Every NBA spread line on Kalshi and Polymarket for a game or a team today: our chance the team covers, the price on each venue and the edge, largest first. The same line on both venues side by side shows where it is priced lower. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

game_id.description: One NBA game, by the game_id that nba_games returns (an ESPN event id). Today's games when left out.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.

team.description: Team code, such as NY, LAL or BOS.

name: nba_spreads
title: NBA spreads
